pages.title: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ specifications
pages.text: The Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ has 1GB LPDDR2 SDRAM and a 1.4GHz 64-bit quad-core processor. It requires a 5V/2.5A micro USB power supply.

pages.title: Raspberry Pi software installation
pages.text: Raspberry Pi Imager writes Raspberry Pi OS to a microSD card. Choose the device, operating system and storage before writing the image.
